basis: 8VC Fund I, L.P. and 8VC Entrepreneurs Fund I, L.P. both signed Asana's Amended and Restated Investors' Rights Agreement (Joe Lonsdale for 8VC GP I, LLC), filed as an exhibit to Asana's January-2020 DRS, i.e. a PRE-IPO venture position. The close report raised Asana as the arista class because the site first lists it in 2022, after the September-2020 direct listing; the exit-side EDGAR sweep already held the answer. Erik's T3 post-IPO ruling (2026-09-06) needs the partnering to postdate the IPO, and here it does not, so the ruling does not reach this row.

Delta A, now settled by Erik's standing partner-carried ruling (2026-09-17): a listing that exists because a partner backed the company at a PREVIOUS firm is not a member. Formation8 Partners led Radius Intelligence's $13M Series B in January 2014 and Joe Lonsdale joined the board as part of that investment; the later $50M round was led by Founders Fund in 2015, before any 8VC fund existed. No 8VC vehicle appears on any Radius filing, the row is on the June-2016 capture only, and Lonsdale's own 2016 8VC bio lists Radius among his board seats.

Delta A, settled by Erik's partner-carried ruling (2026-09-17). Formation 8 led BuildZoom's 2013 seed ($1.4M), its 2014 $2.15M round and its October-2015 $10.6M round, all credited to Formation 8, and no 8VC vehicle appears on any BuildZoom filing. Its founders David Petersen and Jiyan Wei sit on 8VC's 2016 advisors page, which is an association, not fund money (T2). On the June-2016 capture only.

Delta A, settled by Erik's partner-carried ruling (2026-09-17). Nyansa is recorded as venture-backed by Formation 8 and Intel Capital; no 8VC vehicle appears on any Nyansa filing and the company was acquired by VMware in 2020. On the June-2016 capture, the first 8VC list, which carried the predecessor book.

note: 8VC Fund I (2016 vintage) signed the pre-IPO investors' rights agreement, so the position is a private late-stage entry into a company that raised its Series A in 2011; which round the 2016-2019 fund entered is not in the exhibit.
